items.title: Does Raised 2026 Guidance Change The Bull Case For GE Stock?
items.summary: GE Aerospace reported strong third quarter 2026 results, with adjusted earnings up 36% year over year, total orders higher by 49%, and management raising 2026 guidance on the back of a sizeable commercial services and equipment backlog. The mix of a large services backlog, raised guidance, and continued supply chain and defense delivery pressure gives investors a clearer view of both the cash generation potential and the execution risks sitting inside General Electric today. items.title: Exclusive-US should restrict investments in China's aerospace sector, not certify Chinese aircraft, lawmakers say
items.summary: WASHINGTON, Nov 19 (Reuters) - The US government should not certify Chinese-made airplanes and pull contracts from defense contractors, including European aerospace manufacturer Airbus, if they do not halt investments in China's aerospace industrial base, a ‌congressional report reviewed by Reuters said. The House Select Committee on China said in a report Washington should toughen export controls ‌and restrict investments in China's aerospace sector.

items.title: Boeing Is Down 37% From Its High, and Its Jet Unit Is in an “Overstaffed Position.” Is the Selling Overdone?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBoeing just hit a fresh 52-week low, 37% below its January high, because its 737 production ramp keeps slipping and its cash targets keep moving to later years. A 5% cut to its jet workforce and lower October deliveries show the slower ramp is real, and it also matters for engine maker GE Aerospace and for Southwest Airlines, which flies only 737s.
